long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: It is dusk, the telescope is mine, and the sky is worth keeping a note of.
The restlessness needs running off before I settle, and I will do it where I can see the telescope.

today.reason: Hunger cannot be met until the bowl is filled in the morning, and dusk is the time for the telescope and zoomies rather than naps and drawing.
